title: Gold Price Falls Below $3,500 as Core PCE Hits 3.3%
summary: The gold price fell below $3,500 on Nov. 25 as core PCE inflation hit 3.3%, reversing Monday's rebound. What it means for gold ETFs GLD and IAU.
body_markdown:
## Gold Fell 8.71% Alongside Stocks the Week Before


The week before, gold fell with stocks rather than offsetting them. Spot gold traded at $3,543.60 an ounce late on Friday (Nov. 20), down 8.71% on the week, after setting a weekly low of $3,502.93, as hawkish Fed rate expectations, surging Treasury yields and a stronger U.S. dollar "overwhelmed safe-haven demand," according to[Kitco News](https://www.kitco.com/news/article/2026-11-20/wall-street-stays-bearish-after-golds-slide-3500-main-street-pessimism) . Kitco reported that investors liquidated precious-metals positions to cover losses elsewhere as a technology-led equity rout deepened.


Writing on[Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/article/4971769-gold-stopped-protecting-portfolios-when-stocks-needed-it-most) on Nov. 25, contributor Benjamin C. Barry said gold's drop alongside stocks left some investors wondering whether the metal is truly a[hedge](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-hedging-meaning-how-it-works-and-what-it-costs-stock-investors/) against steep equity declines. He measured an 8.9% fall in gold against an 8.61% drop in the S&P 500 during the selloff.


## How Does a Gold ETF Differ From Owning Physical Gold?


A gold ETF investor owns shares in a trust that holds bullion, not the metal itself: each IAU share represents a fractional undivided beneficial interest in the trust's net assets, according to its 10-K. A direct owner of bars or coins holds the metal and arranges its storage.


Custody sits with the funds' banks. GLD's custody agreements provide that all of the trust's gold is held in allocated form at the end of each business day, and Bureau Veritas counts it twice a year at the custodians' vaults, per the SPDR Gold Shares website.


Fees and tracking also set an ETF apart from bullion held directly. GLD aims for its shares to reflect the performance of the price of gold bullion, less the trust's expenses, using the LBMA Gold Price PM as its benchmark. IAU's sponsor's fee accrues daily at an annualized 0.25% of net asset value, per its 10-K. Both funds trade on NYSE Arca.

## What Moved Gold This Week?


Inflation data that reinforced expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening drove Wednesday's drop, according to Trading Economics. Core PCE inflation rose 0.3% in October and the annual rate accelerated to 3.3%, its highest level since 2023, while markets are pricing in an almost certain 25-basis-point rate hike in December.


Gold had already slipped to about $3,510 an ounce on Wednesday[ahead of the PCE report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/stock-market-today-nasdaq-falls-ahead-of-pce-data/) , which Trading Economics described as the last major inflation reading before the Fed's final meeting of the year. A stronger U.S. dollar also weighed on bullion as investors moved away from riskier technology stocks toward safer assets, the same source said.
